the class a third time in this transport: the gateway's contract was 'abort() forwards nothing afterwards', and it kept the stop as its reason text, so the stop held on the easy path only (a reason with words). Found by the reviewer, not by the author's 157 mutations, none of which varied the reason. Fixed: any abort stops the gateway.
